prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1462; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone or in writing.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in question, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, within thirty days of receipt of this letter. Please also confirm the identity of the adjuster assigned to the claim.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, dash camera and telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim file notes, witness contact information, repair or total-loss records, and any communications with third parties. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
